[/list]

These were some of the most important improvements of this update, we will continue to work hard to offer the best possible support, answering your questions and making updates whenever necessary.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II – v 1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/ed4f7f016dcead53c295761b036f26f4db48711b.png[/img]
After receiving feedback from some players, we noticed that many were finding the game much more difficult than Space Elite Force I, making the game a little frustrating for those looking for a more casual experience with the game. After checking and doing several tests in the game, we decided to create two levels of difficulty to suit both types of players, those who want a faster and more casual experience and those more experienced who are looking for a more hardcore game. So we created the “Recruit” and “Elite” difficulty levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/167e8b28927008a66409d0d86c3e43ce211660fb.jpg[/img]
[h1]Recruit Mode[/h1]
In recruit mode, the game offers a more balanced experience, with a difficulty in the right measure and standard of the game. This mode also has checkpoints before each boss or space station, so you don't have to go through all the enemy waves after dying in a boss or space station.
[list]
[*] Checkpoints before each boss.
[*] More balanced level of difficulty.
[*] Fast game.
[/list]
[h1]Elite Mode[/h1]
The elite mode is more cruel, with a higher difficulty and without checkpoints before the bosses or stations. Bosses are also tougher in this mode, making the experience more challenging and time-consuming.
[olist]
[*] No checkpoints.
[*] Higher difficulty level.
[*] Gambling can take longer.
[/olist]
[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
I hope that this small change can offer the best experience for all lovers of spaceship games. Remembering that this change will not affect your saved game, you can play where you left off regardless of the level of difficulty you choose before each game. The choice of difficulty does not affect the standard waves of enemies, they are the same for both modes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/

Thank you, your feedback is very important!
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Controls support.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/52c619aa59051335d6675010e23dd831de15479c.png[/img]
The game works natively with Xinput.dll installed in conjunction with DirectX, which recognizes most controls on the market; we use the Rewired tool, known to most Unity developers, to support the controls. This can cause problems with the Steam emulation system, so follow the recommendation below for a better experience.

Steam (Windows): Sony DualShock 4, generic gamepad, or other joystick doesn't work or appears as two devices
This can happen if the user has enabled PS4 Configuration Support or Generic Gamepad Configuration Support in Steam Big Picture mode under Settings -> Controller or in the main Steam interface in the menu Steam -> Settings -> Controller -> General Controller Settings. Disable PS4, Xbox, and Generic Gamepad Configuration Support to prevent Steam from modifying controller layouts or creating emulated XInput devices for these devices.

[u][b]For the best controller support, it is recommended that you disable Steam's PS4, Xbox, and Generic Gamepad Configuration Support in the Steam App (Steam -> Settings -> Controller -> General Controller Settings)[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/8b3ade41ec94748dc698e53e50c848a6ca691cfc.png[/img]

[h1]Remapping[/h1]
if your control is not pre-configured, the game offers a complete system of remapping keys for these cases. In the options menu, you can remap all the game's functions, including reversing the joystick axis if you need to.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/c82b1df378c7103f2607f9c7cca87522848761e9.png[/img]
